title_en: Clearing opportunity! Near the aviation field, 2+1 for sale with perfect floor plan!
description_en: At the former aviation field, 2+1 apartment for sale with a perfect floor plan!!! The apartment is located on the 1st floor of an 8-story building with an elevator. The property has a gross area of ​​93.13 m2 and a net area of ​​78.45 m2. The apartment is organized in a living room with a kitchenette, a double bedroom, a children's bedroom with access to the balcony, a toilet accessible from the corridor. The orientation of the apartment is East, allowing natural lighting during most of the day. Currently, the construction is in the carabiner stage on the 4th floor and is expected to be completed within a period of 3 years.
